test_title: PYST 48: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 04 Nov, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

Statements:

All laptops are speakers.

Some laptops are desktops.

Conclusions:

(i) Some speakers are desktops.

(ii) Some desktops are not laptops.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

solution:
The least possible venn diagram is;

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3578457b69c562f2c6e9fbc415c8d6ffd07cb696101876537f24b2375d30d47.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(i) Some speakers are desktops → **True **(As, All laptops are speakers, Some laptops are desktops. so, Some speakers are desktops holds true)

(ii) Some desktops are not laptops → False( As, All laptops are speakers, Some laptops are desktops. so, it can be a possibility but not definite)

Thus, Only conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
